newsitem.title: USA: MAY DEPT STORES JULY SAME-STORE SALES RISE.
newsitem.headline: MAY DEPT STORES JULY SAME-STORE SALES RISE.

text.p: May Department Stores Co said Thursday its same-store sales for the four weeks ended August 2, 1997 rose 5.7 percent from the comparable year-ago period.
Total sales in July increased 10.6 percent to $743.2 million from more than $672.0 million in the same period a year ago, the retailer said in a news release.
For the first six months of fiscal 1997, May sales were $5.24 billion, an increase of 9.0 percent over the $4.81 billion during the similar period in fiscal 1996.
Sales have been restated to exclude the sales of stores that have been closed and not replaced.
Year-to-date revenues, including sales of nonreplaced closed stores and finance charge revenue, were $5.42 billion in 1997 and $5.04 billion in 1996.
May operates 366 department stores in 30 states and the District of Columbia.
